record.body:
## Description

Add ~/se-workflow/scripts/dashboard and scripts/tmux-dashboard.conf. The launcher resolves the store and the runtime binary for a directory and execs watch --id project:dashboard. With no store, or no dashboard view in its contract, it prints why and waits for a key. The conf binds prefix + A to a popup and prefix + S to a side pane in #{pane_current_path}. Add a README section on installing the snippet.

payload.title: Launch the dashboard for the current pane's repo
